title: ShellAtol's Secret Doors
description: This datapack adds a 3-block tall secret door that appears on x 100 y 64 z 100. (Structure not included)
body:
This Data pack makes it so that there is a 3-block tall secret door at x 100, y 64, z 100.

<details>
<summary>Video</summary>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xaeLJl_5oDg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>
Throwing a specific item with the tag {SecretDoorKey:1b} will make it so when dropped at the specific xyz (or near) will open the door for 5 seconds.

Try my adveture map [here](https://github.com/shellatol-commits/vigilant-fishstick).
